logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Supporting illustration for the B verification memo of WO-02 (HVAC control package selection). A single-panel vertical bar chart recomputing measured energy per candidate from the trusted table: P4 9 kWh, P3 20, P2 33, P1 50, drawn on one 0-55 kWh linear axis with gridlines and axis labels every 10 kWh, plus a stated scale conversion (1 kWh = 5.09 px) so proportionality is mechanically checkable — directly addressing the round-1 chart-scaling defect. All four bars use one uniform fill color to avoid any per-candidate color coding; each bar carries its value above it and candidate ID below the axis. A bottom strip restates the eligibility gates (quality at least 80, defects at most 5) and each candidate's quality/defect pass result, showing that all four qualify and energy alone decides. Style: clean sans-serif, white background, muted blue bars, thin gray gridlines, no decorative elements.
